fact: The Government of Ghana launched the electronic Integrated Criminal Justice Case Tracking System in 2018, supported by USAID, for the Police Service, EOCO, the Attorney-General's office, the Legal Aid Commission and the Prisons Service to follow criminal cases from arrest to release; it has online, offline and Android versions, and in 2022 the public was still being urged to demand that it be used at police stations.
title: Three NGOs sensitise Greater Accra communities on ADR
